description: Debug & Diagnostics page (Settings > Advanced) -- provides developer tools for troubleshooting GUI automation. The page contains two main sections: Debug Settings for configuring image match debug mode and top match candidate count, and Device Information for viewing and copying system identifiers (Device ID, Device Name, Platform). The page loads settings from the Rust backend via Tauri IPC commands and persists changes on explicit save. Device info supports copy-to-clipboard with visual feedback.
